lifestyle-health.title: Inside Krystle D'Souza's Mumbai Home: Parisian Chic, a Glam Room and Sabyasachi Walls
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The Traitors season 2 winner gave Farah Khan a tour of her self-designed Lokhandwala apartment — from a ₹35,000-a-roll Sabyasachi bedroom wall to a bedroom-sized vanity room.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Television actor Krystle D'Souza. A new feature tours her Mumbai home, from its Parisian-chic interiors to a glam room and Sabyasachi-clad walls.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For design-minded NRIs, the tour offers a template — Parisian detailing, Sabyasachi accents and a dedicated vanity space that translate well to diaspora homes.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Paying Extra for A2 Ghee? Cardiologist Says the Label Is a Fad
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Dr. Darshan Banker and the IFBA's Deepak Jolly say the A1/A2 protein distinction is irrelevant in ghee, which is 99.9% fat — portion size and verified purity matter far more.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A bowl of homemade ghee in Maharashtra. A cardiologist says the premium A2 ghee label is more marketing fad than medicine.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: A2 ghee sells at double or triple the price in diaspora grocery stores on imported health claims that these experts say don't survive scrutiny.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: How PCOS, Obesity and Insulin Resistance Lock Women in a Vicious Cycle
lifestyle-health.excerpt: About two-thirds of women with PCOS have insulin resistance — and each side of the triangle intensifies the other two. Doctors say treating the condition as a metabolic disorder, not just a fertility problem, is the way out.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: PCOS runs high among Indian women and the diaspora, and South Asians develop insulin resistance at lower body weights, making early metabolic screening — not just fertility treatment — especially urgent.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: DNA Hairpin Treatment Cuts Bad Cholesterol Nearly 50% Without Statins
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Scientists in Spain and the United States built short DNA molecules that switch off a cholesterol-regulating gene, cutting blood cholesterol 47% in mice after a single injection — with none of the side effects linked to statins.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A researcher at the National Human Genome Research Institute pipettes DNA from a micro test tube. Scientists used DNA-based polypurine hairpins to block production of the PCSK9 protein, cutting LDL cholesterol nearly 50% in a new study.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians face disproportionately high rates of premature heart disease, so a cheaper, non-statin cholesterol treatment could matter greatly for the diaspora if it survives clinical testing.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Myntra Tech Threads 2026: Where AI, Velocity and Indian Fashion Collide
lifestyle-health.excerpt: At its Bengaluru conclave, Myntra pitched conversational discovery, creator-led shopping and an AI brand stack — arguing Indian fashion is now built in real time, not handed down from runways.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: The Myntra Tech Threads 2026 branding with its 'Where Velocity Meets Voice' tagline. The showcase brings together AI, technology and Indian fashion.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Ethnicwear was a strong awards and runway strand (Biba, House of Pataudi, Taavi) — contemporary Indian occasion wear the diaspora increasingly shops; the honoured homegrown D2C labels are ones diaspora readers seek out.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Sadhguru on Amavasya: Why Tonight's New Moon Is Spiritually Significant
lifestyle-health.excerpt: September's Amavasya tithi runs tonight into tomorrow morning. Sadhguru explains why the moon's absence makes its presence more powerful — and why the new moon suits the hardworking and tough.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Sadhguru sits with folded hands against a dark night sky with the moon visible. He teaches that on Amavasya, the new moon night, the moon's absence makes its presence felt more powerfully.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Strong fit for the site's Spirituality and Daily Wisdom readership — timely tonight, evergreen Sadhguru content, with Isha's large US and UK diaspora following.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Former SBI Manager Quits Over Burnout, Opens Yoga Studio in UP
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A woman working as an assistant manager at the State Bank of India has quit her job, citing constant stress and mental exhaustion, and opened her own yoga studio in Uttar Pradesh — a story picked up by five national outlets that has become one of the week's most-shared conversations about work and wellbeing.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian professionals abroad — where banking, consulting and tech jobs carry the same grind — are having the same conversation about burnout and exit plans; this story lands because the trade-off between a secure job and mental health translates across borders.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Fortis and Takeda Launch 'Mission Dengue Free India' Awareness Campaign
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The nationwide initiative pairs physician-led community sessions with digital outreach to tackle a disease that officially struck over 113,000 Indians in 2025.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A mosquito feeds on human skin. Fortis Healthcare and Takeda have launched a ‘Mission Dengue Free India’ awareness campaign as mosquito-borne infections rise.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Dengue season overlaps with the winter NRI travel window to India; the campaign's prevention guidance is directly relevant to diaspora visitors and their families.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: MasterChef's Jyoti Vishnani on Building an Indian Kitchen Under ₹10,000
food.excerpt: The MasterChef India Season 4 contestant says a great Indian kitchen comes down to ingredients, technique and wisely chosen tools — not expensive gadgets.
food.image_caption: A masala dabba, the Indian spice box. MasterChef India contestant Jyoti Vishnani says a good Indian kitchen comes down to ingredients, technique and the right tools.
food.nri_angle: NRIs setting up first kitchens abroad can build the same starter kit — pressure cooker, kadhai, tawa, masala dabba — for a fraction of a month's eating-out budget.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Which Roti Wins on Protein, Fibre, Iron and Calcium? Nutritionist's Answer
food.excerpt: Nutritionist Kiran Kukreja's comparison finds ragi leads on calcium, amaranth on protein and bajra on magnesium — but her real advice is to rotate grains, not abandon wheat.
food.image_caption: Whole wheat rotis fresh off the griddle. A nutritionist compares roti varieties on protein, fibre, iron and calcium content.
food.nri_angle: Every one of these flours — ragi, jowar, bajra, makki, rajgira — is stocked in Indian grocery stores across the US and Canada, usually at prices close to wheat atta.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Atta Halwa: The Grainy, Ghee-Rich Whole-Wheat Dessert You Can Make in 25 Minutes
food.excerpt: A simple 1:1:1 ratio of flour, ghee and sugar — plus slow roasting and a warm syrup — delivers the danedar, juicy halwa of gurdwara fame, no lumps.
food.nri_angle: Atta halwa uses only ingredients available in any American grocery store, making it one of the most practical Indian desserts for diaspora kitchens.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Lindt Opens Its First-Ever India Store in New Delhi's Aerocity
food.excerpt: The Swiss chocolatier's 1,100 sq ft Worldmark boutique features a 25-flavour LINDOR Pick & Mix bar, live chocolatiers and festive gifting ranges — a first for the brand in India.
food.image_caption: A flat-lay shows Lindt LINDOR truffles and a red gift box. Lindt & Söprüngli opened its first India store at Worldmark, Aerocity, New Delhi, on September 4.
food.nri_angle: A beloved international brand the diaspora grew up buying abroad is now a destination for visitors home — with a gifting angle timed for the Diwali season.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: 'I Won't Eat From Your Hands': Kerala Chef's Reply to Skin-Tone Troll Goes Viral
food.excerpt: Chef Karthikeyan answered a troll who mocked his skin tone by listing the prominent guests he has served — a calm rebuttal that turned colourist abuse into a conversation about dignity.
food.nri_angle: Colourism travels with the diaspora, showing up in casting, workplaces and South Asian grocery aisles abroad; the chef's calm, factual rebuttal resonates across borders.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: In Bengal, Non-Veg Is Not a Treat During Durga Puja — It Is Bhog
food.excerpt: For Bengali families, mutton and hilsa offered to the Goddess on Navami are sacred prasad — a Shakta tradition that stands apart from North India's vegetarian Navratri.
food.image_caption: Bhoga served during Durga Puja in West Bengal, where non-vegetarian offerings like mutton are part of the feast.
food.nri_angle: Bengali-American families reassemble this tradition every autumn at community pujas and Bengali groceries, where khichuri bhog and Navami mutton keep the Shakta meaning of the festival alive abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sri Lankan-Style Coconut Kheema: A Creamy 350-Calorie Weeknight Dinner Fix
food.excerpt: Nutritionist-chef Aathira Sethumadhavan's recipe borrows from Sri Lanka's coconut gravies and Kerala's moilee and mappas, packing 22g of protein into a one-pan chicken kheema dinner with mushrooms and spinach.
food.image_caption: A Sri Lankan-style coconut curry. The kheema dish uses coconut milk and roasted spices for a creamy finish.
food.nri_angle: A 22g-protein one-pan dinner that fits busy Indian-American weeknights, fusing Sri Lankan coconut-gravy technique with pantry staples most diaspora kitchens already have.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sabudana Kheer: The Creamy Fasting Dessert That Needs No Soaking
food.excerpt: This translucent tapioca-pearl kheer is a Navratri and vrat staple, but it works as an everyday dessert too — and a no-soak method cooks the pearls directly in water before the milk goes in.
food.image_caption: A bowl of sabudana kheer, the creamy tapioca-pearl dessert eaten during fasting days.
food.nri_angle: Tapioca pearls are stocked in nearly every Indian grocery in the US, and the no-soak method lets busy diaspora families make this Navratri bhog on a workday evening without planning ahead.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: "Why Did You Lie?": Air India Crew Member Surprises Parents Onboard
travel.excerpt: Sushmita Nath told her parents she was on a different flight — then waited at the aircraft door. Her mother's first words, "Juth kyu boli?" (Why did you lie?), melted millions of hearts.
travel.image_caption: An Air India aircraft. An Air India crew member surprised her parents during a flight in an emotional reunion captured on video.
travel.nri_angle: The video resonates strongly with diaspora families, for whom reunions are rarer and an Air India uniform represents success that circles back to Indian roots.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Diwali Airfares Surge up to 340% on Some Regional Routes
travel.excerpt: One-way economy fares on select festive routes, from Kolkata-Deoghar to Delhi-Patna, have risen two to three times their usual levels as the Durga Puja and Diwali travel rush meets limited seat availability.
travel.image_caption: An Air India passenger aircraft descends for landing with its landing gear deployed. Domestic airfares on select festive routes in India have risen as much as 340% as the Durga Puja and Diwali travel rush fills available seats.
travel.nri_angle: Overseas Indians heading home for the festivals should budget for sharply higher domestic fares on onward legs to tier-2 and tier-3 cities.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Thailand Cuts Visa-Free Stay to 30 Days: What Indian Travellers Must Know
travel.excerpt: From September 15, Thailand replaces its 60-day visa exemption with a 30-day tourism-only category for 60 countries including India, with limits on land-border entries.
travel.image_caption: A graphic confirms Thailand's new 30-day and 15-day visa exemption rules. From September 15, Indian tourists get visa-free entry for up to 30 days, down from 60.
travel.nri_angle: Thailand is among the most popular short-haul leisure destinations for Indians; NRIs and resident Indians planning festive-season trips should confirm entry rules before booking.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo Flight from Lucknow to Dammam Makes Emergency Landing in Ahmedabad After Bomb Note Found
travel.excerpt: All 107 passengers and six crew on flight 6E97 were deplaned safely; nothing suspicious was found after searches by police, CISF, and bomb disposal squads.
travel.nri_angle: The Lucknow-Dammam route is heavily used by Indian migrant workers in the Gulf, for whom such disruptions mean missed workdays and connecting-flight chaos.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: UK Air Traffic Glitch Diverts Bengaluru-London Air India Flight to Vienna
travel.excerpt: A technical fault at Britain's air traffic control provider forced Air India to divert, delay or cancel multiple UK services, as more than 1,000 flights were cancelled across Britain.
travel.image_caption: An Air India aircraft. A Bengaluru-London Air India flight was diverted to Vienna after a UK air traffic glitch.
travel.nri_angle: The India-UK corridor is one of the busiest for Indian travellers and British-Indian families, so the NATS failure ripples directly into diaspora travel plans on both ends.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: DOL Suspends New PERM Green Card Filings by Cognizant, Cloudera
carousel.excerpt: The Labor Department's inspector general froze new permanent labor certification filings at the two tech firms amid a fraud probe — stalling green card sponsorships for thousands of H-1B workers, with no charges yet announced.
carousel.image_caption: TR Immigration social card image accompanying its report on the PERM filing suspensions. The Labor Department inspector general announced on September 8, 2026 that new permanent labor certification filings by Cognizant and Cloudera were frozen during a fraud investigation.
carousel.nri_angle: The freeze stalls green card sponsorships for thousands of Indian H-1B professionals at Cognizant and Cloudera, including the six-year extensions that depend on pending PERM or approved I-140 petitions.

carousel.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Full Itinerary, Timings and What to Watch in New Delhi
carousel.excerpt: Leaders of the expanded 11-member bloc converge on Bharat Mandapam on September 12–13, with the BRICS Business Forum opening today and traffic restrictions across central Delhi.
carousel.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks at a public address, with Indian national flags displayed behind him. Modi hosts the 18th BRICS Leaders’ Summit at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on September 12–13 as India holds the grouping’s 2026 chairship.
carousel.nri_angle: Summit decisions on cross-border payments, national-currency settlement and digital trade set the infrastructure for cheaper remittances and more competitive Indian exporters — and mark India's bid to be a global-economic rule-maker.

carousel.title: From Mardaani to Delhi Crime: Hindi Cinema's Women Cops Take Charge
carousel.excerpt: Rani Mukerji's franchise completed an unprecedented hattrick of hits, while streaming turned Shefali Shah, Sonakshi Sinha and Raveena Tandon into television's most compelling investigators.
carousel.image_caption: Actor Rani Mukerji, whose Shivani Shivaji Roy in the Mardaani franchise is Hindi cinema's defining woman cop. Mardaani 3 closed its 2026 theatrical run at about Rs 77 crore, the series' best.
carousel.nri_angle: Streaming made these performances global by default — Delhi Crime topped charts in 10 countries, giving NRI audiences a second front of Indian storytelling beyond Bollywood tentpoles.

carousel.title: India's New Zealand Tour Sells 50,000 Tickets in Two Weeks
carousel.excerpt: NZ Cricket sold more than 50,000 tickets in just over two weeks for India's first tour in six years, reopening Eden Park's sixth tier for the first time since 2019.
carousel.nri_angle: India fixtures draw the largest and loudest diaspora crowds of any touring side in New Zealand, home to one of the world's fastest-growing Indian communities.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: TCS Opens India's First Lights-Out Factory Lab in Pune for AI Manufacturing
carousel.excerpt: The Industrial Autonomy & Engineering Lab features a fully robotic battery pack assembly line where manufacturers can prototype AI-first production systems before deploying them in real factories.
carousel.image_caption: A robotic arm works on an automated factory production line. TCS launched its Industrial Autonomy & Engineering Lab, described as India's first lights-out factory lab for AI-led manufacturing, at its Pune campus on September 9.
carousel.nri_angle: The lab advances India's positioning in AI-led manufacturing, a sector diaspora investors and tech professionals watch as a signal of where global industrial AI work is heading.

carousel.title: EPF Withdrawal Rules: What EPFO's Simplified Advance Norms Mean for Your Savings
carousel.excerpt: Thirteen withdrawal provisions are now three categories, claims settle in three days, and auto-settlement rises to Rs 5 lakh — but a quarter of your corpus must stay put.
carousel.nri_angle: NRIs holding EPF balances from earlier Indian employment fall under the same simplified rules — another reason to keep UAN-linked records current.
